coding_context.description: Low likehood have effect on abstract construal (Trial 2)
coding_context.reported_success_quote: Contrary to the original empirical findings, we present 2 close replication attempts (N  115 and N  120; the original studies had N  20 and N  34) that failed to find the effect of likelihood on construal level. Bayesian analyses provided diagnostic support for the absence of an effect.
